verdict.rationale: Lever's Automation Hub and Advanced Nurture features describe automated bulk actions (archiving, tagging, emailing, advancing, outreach) across large candidate pools for high-volume hiring, which supports bulk operations at scale. However, evidence does not show an explicit bulk API/endpoint or user-triggered bulk-action interface that an AI-native user could directly invoke across arbitrary item sets. Missing for 10: bulk API endpoints or batch-operation documentation, explicit user-facing bulk-select/action UI evidence, and independent confirmation of scale/performance.
